font.reason: Neutral, variable-weight Persian UI sans suited to the source product-dashboard capsule labels; loaded through FaRoot so the render does not use fallback glyphs.
font.weights: 700 for labels; variable family supports the requested weight without fake bolding

text.notes: The dashboard wireframes contain only skeleton bars and functional color blocks, with no literal UI copy to translate. Persian labels are whole text runs; no letter-by-letter splitting, tracking, uppercase transform, or timing-dependent text reveal is used.

rtlDecisions.what: Carousel item order and track direction
rtlDecisions.action: Changed the track accumulation from increasing/rightward to decreasing/leftward and changed ring positions from trackX - i*SP to trackX + i*SP.
rtlDecisions.why: The next item now starts on the right reading-side rail and advances into the center from right to left, preserving the A→B→C→D feature sequence for RTL readers while keeping all beat values and easing unchanged.

rtlDecisions.action: Horizontally mirrored the complete text-free wireframe body inside each panel.
rtlDecisions.why: The source left navigation rail and topbar order are reading/layout-direction semantics; RTL places the navigation rail on the right. Mirroring the whole skeleton also keeps its repeated cards, chart, rows, switches, and controls visually coherent.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the three fog anchor positions and radial-gradient x anchors.
rtlDecisions.why: The asymmetric color atmosphere supports the layout balance and should follow the mirrored composition; vertical positions and drift equations are unchanged.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the x path from 403→281 to 77→199 and flipped the cursor horizontally with the opposite rotation sign.
rtlDecisions.why: The cursor is an interaction/attention handoff tied to the reading-side carousel. It now approaches the final capsule's left edge from the left while retaining the original hard-appear frame, outQuart travel, endpoint beat, and vertical coordinates.

rtlDecisions.action: Wrapped labels in FaRoot with direction:rtl and faText(14), letterSpacing 0 and lineHeight 1.
rtlDecisions.why: Persian joins correctly as a single run, and the compact one-line capsule keeps the source geometry and readability.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept vertical sinking, scale/opacity/blur formulas, ring size, panel dimensions, chart waveform shape, functional colors, seeds, cursor timing, and duration unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These are physical/universal visual behavior or source motion fidelity, not reading-direction semantics.

comps.rasterHandling: No raster assets are used. All dashboard content is vector/CSS skeleton geometry; no baked-in foreign-language text remains.
comps.timing: Original 120-frame timeline and all BEATS values (0.200/0.483/0.688 with original durations and first-beat tail) were preserved exactly. Label widths were visually checked at the payoff and did not require timing or stage-size changes.

visualVerification.pairsViewed: Persian and matching original stills for every listed frame
visualVerification.result: Pass: label shaping is connected and legible; mirrored rails and carousel direction are coherent; transition beats, resting frame, and cursor handoff are visible and clean.
